definition.name: Fixed-source signed Go HTTP lifecycle replay

steps.name: Install the original captured namespace prerequisite
steps.run:
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install --yes bubblewrap
sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0

steps.name: Test source binding, private diagnostic privacy and real fixture filenames
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_dependency_replay tools.tests.test_go_generator_fixture tools.tests.test_go_private_proxy

steps.name: Retrieve only original qualified products and pinned reproduction tools
Prepare the exact retained Go compiler without rebuilding native products
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
tools="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-dependency-replay-inputs/tools"
echo "ecbadb99091a3f46e31f5f934b068b1864eafa7995211b39eaddf76996045fe5  $tools/go.tar.gz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xzf "$tools/go.tar.gz" -C "$tools"
chmod 700 "$tools/componentize-go" "$tools/wasm-tools"
python3 tools/go_guest/runtime.py --prepare-compiler "$tools/go" --output "$tools/go-async"
echo "$tools/go-async/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
echo "$tools" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Replay the unchanged full normal signed programme first
Fresh component and both original33 and additional9 signed HTTP cases
Retain only public bounded replay identities and node receipts

with.name: go-http-adversarial-replay-${{ github.sha }}
with.path:
${{ runner.temp }}/go-dependency-replay-inputs/retrieval.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-dependency-replay-inputs/source-preimages.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-dependency-replay-baseline/qualification.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-dependency-replay-baseline/node/workflow.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-dependency-replay-baseline/node/FAILED.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/logs/00-fresh-http-component.stdout.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/logs/00-fresh-http-component.stderr.txt
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/project/src/main.go
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/project/capsule-project.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/project/sdk-lock.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/build/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/build/component.wasm
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/build/component.wit
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/standard-node/*.json
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/standard-node/controls/**
${{ runner.temp }}/go-http-adversarial-replay/adversarial-node/*.json
